name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd
title: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd - 533293 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Standalone Q4 sales up 24% to INR1,522 cr with EBITDA margin 12.6%, but capacity push of INR1,400 cr over two years and INR700 cr already underway; management withheld volume/price split and RM pass-through quantum.

capex.quote: we are investing close to INR1,400 crores on that. So that will be our capital allocation for this next two years.

triggers.label: Capex INR1,400 cr over two years
triggers.quote: we are investing close to INR1,400 crores on that. So that will be our capital allocation for this next two years.

triggers.label: Inventory days 66 → 48
triggers.quote: Inventory levels stood at approximately 48 days, which improved from 66 days last quarter.

triggers.label: Standalone Q4 sales +24% YoY
triggers.quote: highest-ever quarterly sales in Q4, reaching INR1,522 crores, a 24% year-on-year growth

guidance.value: Commitment to USD 2 billion company by FY30
guidance.quote: we are progressing well against our goal to be a USD2 billion company by Fiscal Year '30

guidance.value: INR1,400 cr over next two years for 20,000 engines; asset turn 4-5%; peak revenue INR5,000-6,000 cr
guidance.quote: So at the asset turn of 4, you can calculate it will be close to 5,000 crores, 6,000 crores.

guidance.value: Expected to kick in, FY27 aspiration
guidance.quote: we probably will see larger operating leverages kick in soon
